svg.title: AX Studio in 15 seconds: describe a goal, run it in a sandbox, review the changes, and send it to a team cluster
svg.desc: Five screens of AX Studio. On Home, the goal "Fix the flaky signer tests" is typed and Set up task is clicked. On New task, the Antigravity template is ready to run on this computer, and Run task is clicked. On the task's page, it runs in a gVisor sandbox that can reach only github.com, pypi.org and the model API. On Changes, the diff waits for review, with Push to a branch. Then Run on another cluster checks gke-team-dev and sends the task there with ax promote.
svg.text: Describe the outcome you want, then Set up task.
Pick a template and where it runs, then Run task.
The agent works in its own gVisor sandbox, and can reach only the sites you allow.
Review every change before it lands: push a branch or apply it to a folder.
Send the same task to a team cluster with ax promote, checked first.
